plan: The main bug is that the “lagged” model’s features are not actually spline-expanded independently: the pipeline applies `SplineTransformer` to every column, including interaction terms, while the raw change and direction features are poorly specified. The bootstrap also resamples positions from a filtered index list as though they were contiguous, breaking the time-series block structure. The revision uses explicit feature construction, contiguous time blocks, and matched-width contrasts estimated from direction-specific local smooths only over shared support; all scores remain descriptive for this single serial aggregate. It reports sensitivity across prespecified lags and retains the observed-data plot without treating samples as independent replicates.
